note: iOS 27 rolls out today, and it's the biggest change to Apple's notifications in 15 years.

front.title: iOS 27 breaks 15 years of muscle memory on iPhone and iPad
front.tldr: iOS 27, rolling out today, replaces the chronological Notification Center that has existed since iOS 5 in 2011. It is Apple's biggest change yet to how iPhone and iPad surface alerts.

front.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
front.tldr: Perplexity now lets OpenAI's newest model write communications, change software and monitor production systems with far less human check-in than earlier models needed, a real test of agentic AI at work.

front.title: Cynthia Erivo's riveting Prima Facie performance earns TIFF standing ovation
front.tldr: Erivo, already twice Oscar-nominated and a Tony winner, drew a standing ovation in Toronto for her role as a lawyer in Prima Facie, based on Suzie Miller's award-winning play.

stories.title: commit-rewriter 0.1
stories.tldr: Simon Willison built a small web app to clean up commit messages for his Datasette security releases after coding-agent cruft crept into the originals. A tidy, useful fix for a problem AI coding tools create.

stories.title: shot-scraper 1.12
stories.tldr: Willison's screenshot automation tool now supports WebP output, letting users capture web pages in a smaller, modern image format from the command line.

stories.title: What's behind the AI industry's latest warnings of doom?
stories.tldr: TechCrunch's Equity podcast digs into the AI industry's renewed debate over whether the technology poses an existential threat, and why the warnings are growing louder now.

stories.title: The 9 buzziest startups from Y Combinator's latest Demo Day, according to VCs
stories.tldr: VCs picked their favourite companies from YC's summer batch, ranging from floating nuclear reactors to brain chips, a snapshot of where early-stage investors see the next big product.

stories.title: Tesla's second-gen Roadster is finally getting a debut nearly a decade later
stories.tldr: Tesla has set an October 10 reveal date for the long-delayed second-generation Roadster, first shown in prototype form back in 2017.

stories.title: Fusion power startups find new partners in the defense world
stories.tldr: Fusion startups are striking defence-related deals, reviving a relationship between fusion research and national security that had gone quiet but never fully disappeared.

stories.title: TechCrunch Mobility: Lyft has entered the robotaxi chat
stories.tldr: This week's Mobility roundup covers Lyft's move into robotaxis, part of a wider shift in how ride-hailing companies are building around autonomous driving.

stories.title: Here's when iOS 27 rolls out around the world
stories.tldr: iOS 27 arrives today with Apple's more advanced Siri AI capabilities among other refinements, rolling out region by region from around 10am Pacific.

stories.title: Craig Federighi addresses iPhone Duo and iPad overlap
stories.tldr: Apple's software engineering chief spoke to MKBHD about where the new iPhone Duo sits next to the iPad, a week after both launched at Apple's event.

stories.title: Apple planning three major changes for its retail stores, per report
stories.tldr: Bloomberg reports Apple is preparing to overhaul its retail stores, including bringing back dedicated Genius Bars, a reversal of the more open floor layouts introduced years ago.

stories.title: Apple is designing its own game controllers for iPhone, could be Beats branded
stories.tldr: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple is designing two game controllers for iPhone, likely under the Beats brand, corroborating references found earlier in macOS beta code. This is a report, not a confirmed product.

stories.title: Seth Rogen surprised by Toronto Career Achievement Award at 44
stories.tldr: Rogen was honoured alongside Helen Mirren, Penelope Cruz and Isabelle Huppert at TIFF's Tribute Awards, a surprise recognition for the 44-year-old.

stories.title: All That She Wants review: Annie Murphy and Cooper Raiff are well-matched in a generation-gap romcom
stories.tldr: Variety calls this age-gap romcom, named after the 1992 Ace of Base hit, a fizzy showcase for Murphy in her first leading feature role.

stories.title: The Last Photograph review: Zack Snyder comes back down to earth with a violent but surprisingly human action drama
stories.tldr: After years in the DC universe, Snyder returns with a jungle-set action thriller that Deadline's TIFF review finds more grounded and human than expected.

stories.title: How We Stand review: Amber Midthunder stars in a richly drawn, magical-realist Indigenous tale
stories.tldr: Marie Clements' TIFF film examines hidden and violent aspects of recent Indigenous history through a personal, magical-realist lens, per IndieWire's review.

stories.title: Young Guns cast reunites at fan event
stories.tldr: Most of the surviving cast of the late-1980s western gathered in Dallas this weekend, a nostalgic reunion for one of the era's defining ensemble films.

stories.title: A.J. Brown reportedly expected to miss more than 4 weeks due to ankle injury
stories.tldr: Brown is expected to miss around six weeks with an ankle sprain, no surgery planned, a real blow after New England's Week 1 loss to Seattle.

stories.title: Patriots reportedly unwilling to trade away WR Mack Hollins
stories.tldr: Albert Breer reports a 'respected' team enquired about trading for Hollins over Kayshon Boutte, but New England is not interested in moving him.

stories.title: Antonelli wins as Norris loses out under virtual safety car
stories.tldr: Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix, his eighth of the season, after Lando Norris lost a likely victory to the bad timing of a virtual safety car.

stories.title: Norris calls out 'unfair' VSC rules after lost Madrid win
stories.tldr: Norris wants Formula 1 to change its virtual safety car rules after they cost him victory at the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid.

stories.title: Lewis Hamilton 'lucky to make it round' after Spanish GP brake failure
stories.tldr: Hamilton suffered a brake failure early in the Spanish Grand Prix while battling Max Verstappen, and says he was lucky to get back to the garage safely.

stories.title: He knew! Tolle cracks smile before capping immaculate inning
stories.tldr: Rookie Payton Tolle threw the eighth immaculate inning in Red Sox history, and the sixth immaculate first inning in MLB history, in a win over Kansas City.

stories.title: Contreras makes instant impact in Red Sox return
stories.tldr: Willson Contreras was activated from the injured list and made an immediate impact back in the Red Sox lineup.

stories.title: Suarez credits mechanical tweak after consecutive 7-inning gems
stories.tldr: Ranger Suarez struck out eight in another strong outing against the Royals, crediting a mechanical adjustment after a rough August.

finally.title: Johan Sundberg Arkitektur nestles timber summer house within Swedish woodland
finally.tldr: A cross-shaped timber holiday home stretches into a forested, north-facing slope in southern Sweden, a quiet piece of craft to close the day on.
